description: The sum of Lucas numbers from lo through hi inclusive. The sum from L0 through L5 is 28. The sum equals L(hi+2) - L(lo+1). lo must not pass hi. Each index runs from 0 to 4096. Returns JSON with: lo, hi, count, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/lucas-sum
